subject.title: resolveCliAuthEpoch invalidates every live CLI session when local credential source-of-storage flips, even though identity is unchanged

question: What should define the Claude CLI reusable-session auth identity when an OpenClaw auth profile exists but the local Claude credential source appears or disappears?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the safe fix requires maintainer intent on whether to trust profile identity, host credential identity, or fail closed when identity cannot be proven.

options.title: Proven identity only
options.body: Keep sessions reusable across storage-source churn only when the unchanged Claude CLI identity is proven; otherwise fail closed and reset.

options.title: Profile credential is canonical
options.body: Use the selected auth profile as the session identity when present, accepting that identity-less profiles may not detect all host account changes.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Leave storage-presence flips as auth-epoch changes until Claude CLI exposes a stronger stable identity signal.

recommendation.title: Proven identity only
recommendation.body: Keep sessions reusable across storage-source churn only when the unchanged Claude CLI identity is proven; otherwise fail closed and reset.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the auth invalidation behavior and has the strongest history across cli-auth-epoch, cli-session, and prepare.
